title: Fix Payment Management FR data update paths and per-company feature status
summary: Fixed French payment management data migration path by centralizing migration logic, adding separate upgrade tags for object ID remapping, and removing cross-company feature status duplication that incorrectly marked migrations as complete in unmigrated companies.
key_points: Created new codeunit to consolidate payment data migration, ensuring Feature Management path also remaps object IDs
Added separate upgrade tag for remapping to repair companies that migrated before remapping was added
Removed cross-company ModifyAll pattern from feature codeunits that incorrectly copied completion status across all companies
Fixed bank account field direction so RIB data migrates correctly to base application fields
Improved data update requirement check to count all migrated tables and avoid skipping migrations in companies without bank accounts
